scope: Read-only saved-trace and source inspection. No simulation, no native/GPU calls, no full auditor rerun; only this report written.
wrench_semantics: World-axis IPC/STC cached reaction only; right link7 (welded palm) plus both fingers. Moment shifted from aim link origins to aim TCP via cross(origin-TCP,F). Excludes Genesis rigid contact; no per-contact material, normal or tangential decomposition.
key_findings: Final full31 torque 0.15372213996065265 Nm exceeds unchanged 0.15 Nm guard. Full31 52.5-53.18 torque rises from 0.031910 to 0.153722; full30 maximum in same interval is 0.01362723.
From 53.125 to 53.180s, virtually the entire net moment change is link7. The finger moment changes are small; do not interpret the final net as a single contact force.

Full30 nearest final height is at53.140s: torque0.0117671933 Nm, force0.4940694734 N. Height differs by -0.02437mm, but full30 TCP is laterally(-1.54179,+6.04746)mm from full31. This is matched height, not identical actual pose.

Final full31 force points world -X,-Y,+Z; final moment primarily world -Y. Link7 negative-X force acting with ~0.2099m origin-to-TCP Z offset contributes a large negative-Y shift, partly opposed by its positive raw-origin Y torque.
Aggregate wrench cannot establish normal versus friction contribution, which soft object produced each contribution, or causality from higher material stiffness alone.

Source/config-derived IPC friction is identical in full30 and31. Reducing bag friction affects the body, both handles, both robot arms, the bear, table/floor, and bag self contact; it is not a local back-panel friction experiment.

Parent proposed next isolated candidate E10MPa, body shear500N/m, handle shear1000N/m with D/friction/motion/guards unchanged. Present wrench evidence supports preserving friction for interpretability, but cannot predict success or justify a specific stiffness.

friction.evidence_kind: Source-derived coefficients from archived scene/config and active Genesis pair-registration code; saved shell report asserts contact material metadata unchanged. No new native contact-table readback.
friction.scope: One bag entity/contact element; body and handles do not receive different friction coefficients. Tangential regularization present, but source formula alone does not decompose saved wrench.
